subject: website
name: Ethereum File System
summary: The Ethereum File System app, open source (MIT). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it reads chain data from Alchemy, publicnode, Tenderly and Cloudflare RPC endpoints (and the project's devnet server) without a light client, sends WalletConnect telemetry and loads Google Fonts.
